veranderings.rede: The compound verb stillê is written as one word, so the past participle is stilgelê.

veranderings.voor: Die kinders het vir hom gewaai en hy het
veranderings.na: Die kinders het vir hom gewaai, en hy het
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: comma before en when it joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
'daar oor was' reads stiffly; 'oorgebly het' is the natural expression with the same meaning.

veranderings.voor: op die warm sement gelê en daar was
veranderings.na: op die warm sement gelê, en daar was
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: comma before en joining two full clauses (sy bak het gelê / daar was).

veranderings.voor: Ons ken hom nie en hy ken ons
veranderings.na: Ons ken hom nie, en hy ken ons
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: comma before en joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: Hy wou nie hê dat oom Koos in die moeilikheid kom nie.
veranderings.na: Hy wou nie hê oom Koos moet in die moeilikheid kom nie.
veranderings.rede: After 'wou nie hê' Afrikaans naturally uses 'moet' without 'dat'; the bare present 'kom' sits awkwardly in a past narrative.

veranderings.na: wat die twee kinders vertel het
veranderings.rede: The telling happened before the listening in a past narrative, so the past tense 'vertel het' is needed; the protected word vertel is kept.
The adverb reads more naturally after the object: 'die leiband kalm om die hond se nek gesit'.

veranderings.voor: 'n Veearts kyk hom dadelik van kop tot stert na wanneer ons aankom.
veranderings.na: 'n Veearts kyk hom van kop tot stert na sodra ons daar aankom.
veranderings.rede: 'dadelik ... wanneer' is clumsy with the separable verb split far apart; 'sodra' carries the same immediacy more smoothly.
The separable verb tuiskom is written as one word in the past participle: tuisgekom.
